scope: Read-only independent audit of M148 exact-SHA VCS/DC seals, fresh production VCS/DC replay, exhaustive/random tuple-oracle attacks, mapped-DDC evidence, and the M147 independent correction overlay.

score.disposition: GO for the narrow unsigned presence-only destination/source K4 tuple packer and its logic-only 3 ns DC point. NO-GO for signed workload equivalence, same-destination one-cycle execution, the M147 1.805434x opportunity, matched-frequency speedup, physical speedup or system speedup.

independent_protocol_hammer.local_exhaustive_definition: Every one of 65536 possible 16-bit source masks placed independently in each of the eight destinations.
independent_protocol_hammer.cross_destination_exhaustive_definition: Every source pair for all 28 unordered destination pairs: 28 * 16 * 16.

independent_dc_replay.qor_report_difference_from_seal: report timestamp and compile-runtime noise only

findings.title: M148 is a tuple packer, not the same-destination combine engine required by M147
findings.evidence: M148 emits up to four ordered destination/source tuples but has no destination accumulator, coefficient arithmetic or multi-update combine path. The frozen M147 review shows repeated destinations in 35,725,177 of 47,037,211 descriptors (75.95%), including 9,918,824 all-four-same-destination descriptors. Without same-destination combine, corrected cycles are 137,150,654 and the ratio versus M143r2 B4 is 0.987680x, about 1.247% slower.
findings.impact: The independently verified descriptor count does not imply one executable engine cycle per descriptor, so M148 cannot admit or rescue the M147 1.805434x ideal opportunity.
findings.required_fix: Implement a synthesizable non-saturating same-destination combine/update engine with proved accumulator width and overflow behavior, then replay measured ready/stall recurrence.

findings.title: Signed/negate metadata is absent from the row and descriptor interfaces
findings.evidence: The RTL input is only row_event_mask and each tuple carries destination, source and valid. There is no row_negate_mask or per-tuple sign/negate output; the M147 ledger is explicitly ordered presence tuples and its storage lower bound excludes sign/valid/count/alignment/ECC.
findings.impact: Presence conservation is not signed numeric equivalence for the actual parent-delta workload, and the current area/timing does not price sign selection/storage.
findings.required_fix: Carry a 128-bit negate/sign mask into M148, emit aligned per-tuple sign metadata, and rerun the exhaustive tuple-plus-sign oracle, DC and downstream arithmetic proof.

findings.title: Production SVA does not independently state full tuple conservation or descriptor-count recurrence
findings.evidence: Production SVA checks tuple order, valid shape, count encoding, last definition and stability, while exact multiset conservation and ceil(popcount/4) are implemented in the production procedural scoreboard. observed_next_sequence is connected but unused by SVA.
findings.required_fix: Adopt a transaction-level reference monitor or bounded formal conservation property and add explicit accepted-sequence progression/reset properties.

findings.title: No RTL-to-mapped-netlist Formality seal is admitted
findings.evidence: Exact VCS, mapped Verilog/SDC/DDC and SVF exist, and the mapped DDC reopens with matching QoR, but no completed M148 Formality receipt was found.
findings.required_fix: Run exact-SHA RTL-to-final-mapped-netlist Formality before treating the mapped implementation as functionally admitted.

findings.title: The DC point is logic-only and prephysical
findings.evidence: 2183.957994 um2 and +0.6266 ns setup reproduce cleanly, but the run uses ideal clock, ZeroWireload, zero macros and no routing or activity power; hold margin is only +0.0002 ns in DC.
findings.required_fix: Keep the result as packer logic-only evidence and run propagated-clock PT/PTPX with realistic loads if physical frequency or energy is cited.

findings.title: Completion and reset cancellation remain integration contracts
findings.evidence: A zero row produces done_valid on the same accepted edge and done has no ready/acknowledgement. Mid-active rst_core discards remaining tuples without a completion, which the independent hammer confirms as the implemented reset behavior.
findings.required_fix: Freeze same-edge done capture and atomic reset cancellation at integration, or add a registered/acknowledged completion and flush protocol.

admitted: exact-SHA production VCS counts and eight nonzero SVA covers
ordered unsigned destination/source presence tuple multiset conservation over the independent exhaustive/random corpus
per-row descriptor count equal to ceil(total presence popcount / 4)
zero-row accepted-cycle floor, fallthrough, descriptor II1 and stable backpressure behavior
sequence quarantine, reset recovery and single-outstanding modulo wrap behavior
flattened TSMC28 standard-cell tuple-packer logic-only area and ideal-clock ZeroWireload timing at 3 ns
not_admitted: one executable PWP cycle per M148 descriptor
engine arithmetic, coefficient/weight storage or descriptor/result SRAM macros
propagated-clock/routed timing, SAIF/PTPX power or energy
paper PPA readiness, DATE headline or best-paper readiness
